id.description: What it's asked for by: a container's, image's, volume's or network's id, a Compose project's name.

keys.description: Each column's sort key: a number or text.

tones.description: Each column's tone (ok, warn, bad), or empty.

tips.description: Each column's tooltip, or empty (an age's: its time in full).

filters.description: What each column's filter goes by, where it isn't the column's text, else empty (a container's Status: its state, Running or Exited, where the text says for how long).

actions.description: What can be done to it as it is: start, stop, restart, remove.

logs.description: It has a log to follow (docker_follow).

shell.description: A running container's: the command that opens a shell in it (bash if it has it, else sh), for a terminal on the host; else empty.

running.description: A container that's running, or a Compose project with one running.
